sources.note: IEC 60320 article (opened): C13 is the connector (cable end, socket contacts) that mates with the C14 inlet (matesWith iec-c14 in the catalog). The standard sheet and a manufacturer outline drawing were not available: the head 24.8 x 16.8 mm (fits the 25.4 x 17.4 mm pocket of the modelled inlet) with the same cut lower corners and three slots, 22 mm long, a 31 x 22 mm body 12 mm long and a tapering boot to 56 mm overall are ESTIMATES. Retail pages quote a C13 body 22.78 mm wide at the base and 15.6 mm high (secondary, not used for a number).
The C14 inlet it plugs into: shroud 27.5 x 19.5 mm (Schurter).
